description: This source file defines a React component for the homepage of a recipe discovery application. It features imports of recipe data functions, UI components, and Next.js features. The component dynamically fetches featured recipes or search results based on query parameters and renders a structured, interactive interface including search, links, and recipe grid.

methods.name: Home
methods.description: Asynchronous React component that fetches recipe data and renders the homepage UI, including search functionality, featured recipes, and navigation links.
